Owner.description:
The owner of a zone or lore entry: a pilot (git email) or a team.

On the wire it is a single string: an email address, or `team:<name>` where `<name>` is a key
of the `[teams]` table in `territory.toml`.

SpecVersion.description:
The `spec` field of a document: the version of the ACS spec it was written against.

The only supported value is `"acs/0.1"`. Readers MUST reject any other value.

kind.description: How strictly the zone is controlled.

owners.description:
Who owns the zone. Meaningful for `owned` zones; may be listed on any zone for review
routing.

paths.description: Globs of the paths the zone covers. When zones overlap, the most specific match wins.

ZoneKind.description: How strictly a zone of the repository is controlled.

oneOf.description:
Only the owners' agents may change it; other agents are denied. Implementations that do
not yet enforce ownership MUST treat `owned` zones as `shared`.
Any agent may change it after taking a claim.
Any agent may change it without a claim.

description:
`.acs/policy/territory.toml`: who may change what. Every field defaults to empty, which makes
the whole repository `shared`.

spec.description: Optional spec version. If present it must be `acs/0.1`.

teams.description: Team name to member git emails, referenced from `owners` as `team:<name>`.

title: Territory
